run_PPOAgent_benchmark: run a PPO agent benchmark evaluation with a specified model checkpoint and task config
create_PPOAgentConfig: create a PPOAgentConfig dataclass with rgb input type and default Gibson model path
create_PPOAgent: create a PPOAgent instance that loads a PointNavResNetPolicy from a checkpoint file

review_PPOAgent_reset: review the PPOAgent reset method that initializes recurrent hidden states and masks
